analogy.rationale: Histamine receptor modulators act mainly on HRH1/HRH2/HRH4, which are poorly expressed in these cell lines, so transcriptional responses should be weak; the closest reference classes are other histamine receptor ligands, with PDE4 inhibition as a minor off-target similarity given the annotated PDE4 targets.
